title: Performance Optimization - Quiz
description: Test your understanding of performance optimization concepts in PEGA

questions.question: What is the first step in performance optimization?
questions.explanation: Performance optimization should begin with comprehensive analysis and bottleneck identification to understand where improvements will have the greatest impact.

questions.question: How do database indexes improve performance?
options: By reducing query execution time through efficient data retrieval
questions.explanation: Database indexes improve performance by reducing query execution time through efficient data retrieval, allowing the database to quickly locate relevant records.

questions.question: When should you implement caching strategies?
options: For frequently accessed data and expensive computations
questions.explanation: Caching strategies should be implemented for frequently accessed data and expensive computations to reduce processing time and improve response times.

questions.question: What is the benefit of query optimization?
options: It improves database performance through efficient SQL execution
questions.explanation: Query optimization improves database performance through efficient SQL execution, reducing resource consumption and improving application responsiveness.

questions.question: How do you identify memory leaks?
options: Through memory profiling tools and monitoring
questions.explanation: Memory leaks are identified through memory profiling tools, monitoring tools, and performance analysis to detect abnormal memory consumption patterns.

questions.question: What is crucial for connection pool optimization?
options: Balanced pool sizing based on workload and resource constraints
questions.explanation: Connection pool optimization requires balanced sizing based on workload patterns and resource constraints to maximize performance without overwhelming resources.

questions.question: How should you monitor application performance?
options: Through comprehensive monitoring tools, metrics, and alerting
questions.explanation: Application performance should be monitored through comprehensive tools, metrics collection, real-time dashboards, and alerting systems to proactively identify issues.

questions.question: What is the benefit of load testing?
options: It identifies performance bottlenecks under realistic load conditions
questions.explanation: Load testing identifies performance bottlenecks under realistic load conditions, helping ensure applications can handle expected user volumes and peak loads.
